translations.literal: His outrage overflowed and wickedness was full; he turned his head with nowhere to lean, taking Jinling, lair of fugitives, and the lands of Jiangnan where exiles dwell—sweet words and humble rites, advancing to seize his own body—his deceitful speech and floating claims may well be known.
translations.idiomatic: His outrage overflowed; he turned his head with nowhere to lean, taking Jinling, lair of fugitives, and Jiangnan, land of exiles—sweet words and humble rites to save himself; his deceit may well be known.

sentences.zh: 而偽朝大小，幸災忘義，主荒於上，臣蔽於下，連結奸惡，斷絕鄰好，徵兵保境，縱盜侵國。

translations.literal: Yet great and small of the false court rejoiced in disaster and forgot righteousness; the ruler was lost above, ministers screened below; they linked with the wicked, cut off neighborly peace, raised troops to guard borders, and let robbers invade the state.
translations.idiomatic: Yet great and small of the false court rejoiced in disaster; the ruler was lost above, ministers screened below; they linked with the wicked, cut off neighbors, raised troops, and let robbers invade.

sentences.zh: 蓋物無定方，事無定勢，或乘利而受害，或因得而更失。

translations.literal: Things have no fixed direction, affairs no fixed momentum—sometimes one rides profit into harm, sometimes gain becomes loss again.
translations.idiomatic: Things have no fixed direction—sometimes profit becomes harm, sometimes gain becomes loss.

sentences.zh: 是以吳侵齊境，遂得句踐之師，趙納韓地，終有長平之役。

translations.literal: Thus Wu invaded Qi and thereby won Goujian's army; Zhao took Han lands and in the end met the battle of Changping.
translations.idiomatic: Wu invaded Qi and thereby won Goujian's army; Zhao took Han lands and met Changping.

sentences.zh: 矧乃鞭撻疲民，侵軼徐部，築壘擁川，捨舟徼利。

translations.literal: How much more when they lash the weary people, raid Xu province, build ramparts to choke the rivers, and abandon boats to snatch profit!
translations.idiomatic: How much more when they lash the weary people, raid Xu, build ramparts to choke the rivers, and abandon boats to snatch profit!

sentences.zh: 是以援枹秉麾之將，拔距投石之士，含怒作色，如赴私仇。

translations.literal: Hence the generals who beat the drum and hold the banner, the soldiers who wrestle and cast stones, bear anger on their faces as if to a private feud.
translations.idiomatic: Hence generals who beat the drum and hold the banner, soldiers who wrestle and cast stones, bear anger as for a private feud.

sentences.zh: 彼連營擁眾，依山傍水，舉螳□良之斧，被蛣蜣之甲，當窮轍以待輪，坐積薪而候燎。

translations.literal: They mass camps and crowd hosts, lean on mountains and hug the water, raise mantis-arm axes, don dung-beetle armor, wait in a broken rut for the wheel, sit on piled kindling for the flame.
translations.idiomatic: They mass camps and crowd hosts, lean on mountains and hug the water, raise mantis-arm axes, don dung-beetle armor, wait in a broken rut for the wheel, sit on piled kindling for the flame.

sentences.zh: 及鋒刃暫交，埃塵且接，已亡戟棄戈，土崩瓦解，掬指舟中，衿甲鼓下，同宗異姓，縲紲相望。

translations.literal: When blades briefly met and dust rose between them, halberds were already lost and spears cast aside—the earth crumbled and walls gave way; fingers were cupped in boats, armor at the breast under drums; kin of one clan and different surnames, bonds and fetters in sight of one another.
translations.idiomatic: When blades met and dust rose, halberds were lost and spears cast aside—earth crumbled and walls gave way; fingers cupped in boats, armor at the breast under drums; kin and strangers, bonds in sight of one another.

sentences.zh: 曲直既殊，強弱不等，獲一人而失一國，見黃雀而忘深阱，智者所不為，仁者所不向。

translations.literal: Right and wrong were already different, strong and weak unequal—to gain one man and lose a state, see the yellow sparrow and forget the deep pit—what the wise do not do, what the humane do not face.
translations.idiomatic: Right and wrong differed, strong and weak were unequal—to gain one man and lose a state, see the yellow sparrow and forget the deep pit—what the wise do not do, what the humane do not face.

sentences.zh: 誠既往之難逮，猶將來之可追。

translations.literal: Truly the past is hard to reach again, yet the future may still be pursued.
translations.idiomatic: The past is hard to reach again, yet the future may still be pursued.

sentences.zh: 侯景以鄙俚之夫，遭風雲之會，位班三事，邑啟萬家，揣身量分，久當止足。

translations.literal: Hou Jing, a vulgar fellow, met the hour of wind and cloud, ranked among the Three Dignities, fiefs opened to ten thousand households—measuring body and portion, he should long since have stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing, a vulgar fellow, met the hour of wind and cloud, ranked among the Three Dignities, fiefs to ten thousand households—measuring body and portion, he should long since have stopped.

sentences.zh: 而周章向背，離披不已，夫豈徒然，意亦可見。

translations.literal: Yet he wavered to and fro without cease—was it for nothing? His intent may be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he wavered to and fro without cease—was it for nothing? His intent may be seen.

sentences.zh: 彼乃授之以利器，誨之以慢藏，使其勢得容奸，時堪乘便。

translations.literal: They gave him sharp tools and taught him careless keeping, letting his power harbor treachery and the moment be seized for advantage.
translations.idiomatic: They gave him sharp tools and taught him careless keeping, letting his power harbor treachery and the moment be seized.

sentences.zh: 今見南風不競，天亡有征，老賊奸謀，將復作矣。

translations.literal: Now the southern wind does not contend; Heaven's ruin has its sign; the old villain's treacherous plot will act again.
translations.idiomatic: Now the southern wind does not contend; Heaven's ruin has its sign; the old villain's plot will act again.

sentences.zh: 然推堅強者難為功，摧枯朽者易為力。

translations.literal: Yet pushing the hard and strong is hard to accomplish; breaking the withered and rotten is easy in strength.
translations.idiomatic: Pushing the hard and strong is hard; breaking the withered and rotten is easy.

sentences.zh: 計其雖非孫、吳猛將，燕、趙精兵，猶是久涉行陳，曾習軍旅，豈同剽輕之師，不比危脆之眾。

translations.literal: Counting that though they are not fierce generals of Sun and Wu, nor picked troops of Yan and Zhao, they are still long seasoned in the ranks and practiced in armies—how are they like a light raiding host or a brittle, perilous crowd?
translations.idiomatic: Though they are not Sun and Wu's fierce generals nor Yan and Zhao's picked troops, they are long seasoned in the ranks—how are they like a light raiding host or a brittle crowd?

sentences.zh: 拒此則作氣不足，攻彼則為勢有餘，終恐尾大於身，踵粗於股，倔強不掉，狼戾難馴。

translations.literal: Resist these and their fighting spirit falls short; attack those and momentum has surplus—in the end one fears tail larger than body, heel thicker than thigh, stubborn and unyielding, savage and hard to tame.
translations.idiomatic: Resist these and spirit falls short; attack those and momentum has surplus—in the end tail outgrows body, heel outgrows thigh, stubborn and savage, hard to tame.

sentences.zh: 呼之則反速而釁小，不征則叛遲而禍大。

translations.literal: Summon them and they rebel quickly with small outrage; do not campaign and rebellion is slow but calamity great.
translations.idiomatic: Summon them and they rebel quickly with small outrage; do not campaign and rebellion is slow but calamity great.

sentences.zh: 會應遙望廷尉，不肯為臣，自據淮南，亦欲稱帝。

translations.literal: Soon he will gaze from afar at the Court Director, refuse to be minister, hold Huainan himself, and wish to style himself emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he will gaze at the Court Director, refuse to be minister, hold Huainan, and wish to style himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 但恐楚國亡猿，禍延林木，城門失火，殃及池魚。

translations.literal: Yet one fears that when Chu lost its ape, disaster spread to the woods; when the gate caught fire, the fish in the pool suffered.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when Chu lost its ape, disaster spread to the woods; when the gate caught fire, the fish in the pool suffered.

sentences.zh: 橫使江、淮士子，荊、揚人物，死亡矢石之下，夭折霧露之中。

translations.literal: In vain Jiang and Huai scholars, Jing and Yang men of note, die under arrows and stones and perish young in mist and dew.
translations.idiomatic: In vain Jiang and Huai scholars, Jing and Yang men of note, die under arrows and stones and perish young in mist and dew.

sentences.zh: 彼梁主，操行無聞，輕險有素，射雀論功，盪舟稱力，年既老矣，耄又及之，政散民流，禮崩樂壞。

translations.literal: That Liang ruler—conduct unheard of, frivolity and peril his nature, shooting sparrows to discuss merit, capsizing boats to boast strength—years already old, dotage upon him; government scattered, people adrift, rites collapsed and music ruined.
translations.idiomatic: That Liang ruler—conduct unheard of, frivolity his nature, shooting sparrows for merit, capsizing boats to boast strength—old, doting; government scattered, people adrift, rites collapsed and music ruined.

sentences.zh: 加以用捨乖方，廢立失所，矯情動俗，飾智驚愚，毒螫滿懷，妄敦戒業，躁競盈胸，謬治清淨。

translations.literal: Add to this use and dismissal contrary to measure, establishment and removal out of place, feigned feeling to move custom, adorned wit to startle fools, venom stings filling the breast, vainly urging restraint and karma, rash striving filling the chest, falsely governing purity and stillness.
translations.idiomatic: Add use and dismissal contrary to measure, establishment out of place, feigned feeling, adorned wit to startle fools, venom in the breast, vain restraint, rash striving in the chest, false purity.

sentences.zh: 災異降於上，怨讟興於下，人人厭苦，家家思亂，履霜有漸，堅冰且至。

translations.literal: Portents descend above, resentment rises below; every man hates his lot, every house thinks of disorder—treading frost has its stages, solid ice is near.
translations.idiomatic: Portents descend above, resentment rises below; every man hates his lot, every house thinks of disorder—treading frost has its stages, solid ice is near.

sentences.zh: 傳險躁之風俗，任輕薄之子孫。

translations.literal: They pass on reckless, rash custom and entrust frivolous sons and grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: They pass on reckless custom and entrust frivolous sons and grandsons.

sentences.zh: 朋黨路開，兵權在外。

translations.literal: Faction opens the road; military power lies outside.
translations.idiomatic: Faction opens the road; military power lies outside.

sentences.zh: 必將禍生骨肉，釁起腹心，強弩沖城，長戈指闕；

translations.literal: Calamity will surely rise from flesh and bone, outrage from the belly and heart; strong crossbows will strike the wall, long spears point at the palace gate;
translations.idiomatic: Calamity will rise from flesh and bone, outrage from the belly and heart; strong crossbows will strike the wall, long spears point at the palace gate;

sentences.zh: 徒探雀鷇，無救府藏之虛，空請熊蹯，詎延晷刻之命。

translations.literal: vainly they reach for sparrow fledglings and cannot save the treasury's emptiness; empty they beg for bear paws and cannot extend life by a moment.
translations.idiomatic: vainly they reach for sparrow fledglings and cannot save the empty treasury; empty they beg for bear paws and cannot extend life by a moment.

sentences.zh: 外崩中潰，今實其時。

translations.literal: Outward collapse and inward breach—now is truly the hour.
translations.idiomatic: Outward collapse and inward breach—now is truly the hour.

sentences.zh: 鷸蚌相持，我乘其弊。

translations.literal: Snipe and clam hold each other; we ride their exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: Snipe and clam hold each other; we ride their exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 方使駿騎追風，精甲輝日，四七並列，百萬為群，以轉石之形，為破竹之勢。

translations.literal: We shall send swift horses chasing the wind, keen armor gleaming in the sun, four and seven arrayed together, a million as one host, the form of rolling stone becoming the momentum of splitting bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: We shall send swift horses chasing the wind, keen armor gleaming in the sun, hosts arrayed in ranks, a million as one, rolling stone becoming splitting bamboo.

sentences.zh: 當使鐘山渡江，青蓋入洛，荊棘生於建業之宮，糜鹿游於姑蘇之館。

translations.literal: Zhong Mountain shall cross the river, the green-canopied carriage enter Luoyang; brambles shall grow in the palace of Jianye, elk wander in the halls of Gusu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Mountain shall cross the river, the green-canopied carriage enter Luoyang; brambles shall grow in Jianye's palace, elk wander in Gusu's halls.

sentences.zh: 但恐革車之所□藺轢，劍騎之所蹂踐，杞梓於焉傾折，竹箭以此摧殘。

translations.literal: Yet one fears where war chariots crush and trample, where sword and horse tread down— catalpa and zelkova there broken, bamboo and arrow shafts there ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Yet one fears where war chariots crush and trample, where sword and horse tread down—fine timber broken, bamboo shafts ruined.

sentences.zh: 若吳之王孫，蜀之公子，歸款軍門，委命下吏，當即授客卿之秩，特加驃騎之號。

translations.literal: If princes of Wu and sons of Shu come in submission to the camp gate and entrust their lives to lower officers, they shall at once receive the rank of guest minister and be specially given the title Rapid Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: If princes of Wu and sons of Shu come in submission and entrust their lives to lower officers, they shall receive the rank of guest minister and the title Rapid Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 凡百君子，勉求多福。

translations.literal: All you gentlemen, strive to seek much blessing.
translations.idiomatic: All you gentlemen, strive to seek much blessing.

sentences.zh: 」其後梁室禍敗，皆如弼言。

translations.literal: " Afterward the house of Liang met disaster and defeat—all as Bi had said.
translations.idiomatic: " Afterward the house of Liang met disaster and defeat—all as Du Bi had said.

sentences.zh: 侯景圍譙城，不下。

translations.literal: Hou Jing besieged Qiao city and could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing besieged Qiao city and could not take it.

sentences.zh: 退攻城父，拔之。

translations.literal: He withdrew and attacked Chengfu and took it.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew, attacked Chengfu, and took it.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣其行台左丞王偉等詣建康說上曰：「鄴中文武合謀，召臣共討高澄。

translations.literal: On renshen, he sent his mobile headquarters left director Wang Wei and others to Jiankang to persuade the emperor, saying, "Civil and military men at Ye plotted together and summoned me to join in punishing Gao Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, he sent his mobile headquarters left director Wang Wei and others to Jiankang to tell the Liang emperor, "Civil and military men at Ye plotted together and summoned me to join in punishing Gao Cheng.

sentences.zh: 事洩，澄幽元善見於金墉，殺諸元六十餘人。

translations.literal: The affair leaked; Cheng imprisoned Yuan Shanjian at Jinyong and killed more than sixty of the Yuans.
translations.idiomatic: The affair leaked; Gao Cheng imprisoned Yuan Shanjian at Jinyong and killed more than sixty of the Yuans.

sentences.zh: 河北物情，俱念其主，請立元氏一人以從人望，如此，則陛下有繼絕之名，臣景有立功之效。

translations.literal: Sentiment in Hebei all yearns for its lord; we ask to establish one of the Yuan clan to follow men's hopes—thus Your Majesty gains the name of continuing a broken line, and your servant Jing the merit of achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Sentiment in Hebei yearns for its lord; establish one of the Yuan clan to follow men's hopes—thus Your Majesty gains the name of continuing a broken line, and your servant Jing the merit of achievement.

sentences.zh: 河之南北，為聖朝之邾、莒；

translations.literal: North and south of the river shall be Zhu and Ju to the holy court;
translations.idiomatic: North and south of the river shall be Zhu and Ju to the holy court;

sentences.zh: 國之男女，為大梁之臣妾。

translations.literal: the men and women of those states, subjects and handmaids of Great Liang.
translations.idiomatic: its men and women, subjects and handmaids of Great Liang.

sentences.zh: 」上以為然，乙亥，下詔以太子舍人元貞為咸陽王，資以兵力，使還北主魏，須渡江，許即位，儀衛以乘輿之副給之。

translations.literal: " The emperor thought it so; on yihai he issued an edict making Crown Prince Household Attendant Yuan Zhen Prince of Xianyang, supplying him with troops to return north and rule Wei—once he crossed the river, enthronement was permitted, and guard and escort were given as for the imperial carriage's deputy.
translations.idiomatic: " The Liang emperor agreed; on yihai he made Crown Prince Household Attendant Yuan Zhen Prince of Xianyang, supplied him with troops to return north and rule Wei—once he crossed the river, enthronement was permitted, and guard and escort were given as for the imperial carriage's deputy.

sentences.zh: 貞，樹之子也。

translations.literal: Zhen was Shu's son.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was the son of Yuan Shu.

sentences.zh: 蕭淵明至鄴，東魏主升閶闔門受俘，讓而釋之，送於晉陽，大將軍澄待之甚厚。

translations.literal: When Xiao Yuanming reached Ye, the Eastern Wei ruler ascended the Gate of Universal Peace to receive the captive, declined and released him, sent him to Jinyang, and Grand General Cheng treated him very generously.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiao Yuanming reached Ye, the Eastern Wei emperor ascended the Gate of Universal Peace to receive the captive, declined and released him, sent him to Jinyang, and Gao Cheng treated him very generously.

sentences.zh: 慕容紹宗引軍擊侯景，景輜重數千兩，馬數千匹，士卒四萬人，退保渦陽。

translations.literal: Murong Shaozong led troops against Hou Jing; Jing had several thousand baggage carts, several thousand horses, and forty thousand soldiers, and withdrew to hold Woyang.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Shaozong led troops against Hou Jing; Jing had several thousand baggage carts, several thousand horses, and forty thousand soldiers, and withdrew to hold Woyang.

sentences.zh: 紹宗士卒十萬，旗甲耀日，鳴鼓長驅而進。

translations.literal: Shaozong had a hundred thousand soldiers; banners and armor dazzled the sun; drums sounded as they drove forward at length.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozong had a hundred thousand soldiers; banners and armor dazzled the sun; drums sounded as they drove forward.

sentences.zh: 景使謂之曰：「公等為欲送客，為欲定雌雄邪？

translations.literal: Jing sent word: "Are you gentlemen wishing to see guests off, or to decide victor and vanquished?
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing sent word: "Are you wishing to see guests off, or to decide victor and vanquished?

sentences.zh: 」紹宗曰：「欲與公決勝負。

translations.literal: " Shaozong said, "I wish to settle victory and defeat with you.
translations.idiomatic: " Shaozong said, "I wish to settle victory and defeat with you.

sentences.zh: 」遂順風布陳。

translations.literal: " He then deployed his array with the wind.
translations.idiomatic: " He then deployed his array with the wind.

sentences.zh: 景閉壘，俟風止乃出。

translations.literal: Jing shut the ramparts and waited for the wind to stop before coming out.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing shut the ramparts and waited for the wind to stop before coming out.

sentences.zh: 紹宗曰：「侯景多詭計，好乘人背。

translations.literal: Shaozong said, "Hou Jing has many deceitful schemes and likes to strike men's backs.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozong said, "Hou Jing has many deceitful schemes and likes to strike from behind.

sentences.zh: 」使備之，果如其言。

translations.literal: " He had them prepare, and it was indeed as he said.
translations.idiomatic: " He had them prepare, and it was indeed as he said.

sentences.zh: 景命戰士皆被短甲，執短刀，入東魏陳，但低視，斫人脛馬足。

translations.literal: Jing ordered his warriors all to wear short armor, hold short blades, enter the Eastern Wei array, look only downward, and hack men's shins and horses' legs.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing ordered his warriors to wear short armor, hold short blades, enter the Eastern Wei array, look only downward, and hack men's shins and horses' legs.

sentences.zh: 東魏兵遂敗，紹宗墜馬，儀同三司劉豐生被傷，顯州刺史張遵業為景所擒。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei troops were routed; Shaozong fell from his horse; Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes Liu Fengsheng was wounded; Xianzhou inspector Zhang Zunye was captured by Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei troops were routed; Shaozong fell from his horse; Liu Fengsheng, Equal to the Three Dukes, was wounded; Zhang Zunye, inspector of Xian, was captured by Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 紹宗、豐生俱奔譙城，裨將斛律光、張恃顯尤之，紹宗曰：「吾戰多矣，未見如景之難克者也。

translations.literal: Shaozong and Fengsheng both fled to Qiao city; subordinate generals Hulu Guang and Zhang Shixian blamed him; Shaozong said, "I have fought many battles and never seen one so hard to overcome as Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozong and Fengsheng both fled to Qiao city; subordinate generals Hulu Guang and Zhang Shixian blamed him; Shaozong said, "I have fought many battles and never seen one so hard to overcome as Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 君輩試犯之！

translations.literal: You gentlemen, try attacking him!
translations.idiomatic: You gentlemen, try attacking him!

sentences.zh: 」光等被甲將出，紹宗戒之曰：「勿渡渦水。

translations.literal: " Guang and the others donned armor and were about to go out; Shaozong warned them, "Do not cross the Wo River.
translations.idiomatic: " Guang and the others donned armor and were about to go out; Shaozong warned them, "Do not cross the Wo River.

sentences.zh: 」二人軍於水北，光輕騎射之。

translations.literal: " The two encamped north of the water; Guang with light horse shot at him.
translations.idiomatic: " The two encamped north of the water; Guang with light horse shot at him.

sentences.zh: 景臨渦水謂光曰：「爾求勳而來，我懼死而去。

translations.literal: Jing stood by the Wo River and said to Guang, "You came seeking merit; I fear death and would leave.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing stood by the Wo River and said to Guang, "You came seeking merit; I fear death and would leave.

sentences.zh: 我，汝之父友，何為射我？

translations.literal: I am your father's friend—why shoot me?
translations.idiomatic: I am your father's friend—why shoot me?

sentences.zh: 汝豈自解不渡水南？

translations.literal: Do you not understand for yourself not to cross south of the water?
translations.idiomatic: Do you not understand for yourself not to cross south of the water?

sentences.zh: 慕容紹宗教汝也！

translations.literal: Murong Shaozong taught you that!
translations.idiomatic: Murong Shaozong taught you that!

sentences.zh: 」光無以應。

translations.literal: " Guang had nothing to answer.
translations.idiomatic: " Guang had nothing to answer.

sentences.zh: 景使其徒田遷射光馬，洞胸；

translations.literal: Jing had his follower Tian Qian shoot Guang's horse, piercing its chest;
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing had his follower Tian Qian shoot Guang's horse, piercing its chest;

sentences.zh: 光易馬隱樹，又中之，退入於軍。

translations.literal: Guang changed horses and hid behind a tree; he was hit again and withdrew into the army.
translations.idiomatic: Guang changed horses and hid behind a tree; he was hit again and withdrew into the army.

sentences.zh: 景擒恃顯，既而捨之。

translations.literal: Jing captured Shixian and then released him.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing captured Shixian and then released him.

sentences.zh: 光走入譙城，紹宗曰：「今定何如，而尤我也！

translations.literal: Guang ran into Qiao city; Shaozong said, "Now how is it, that you blame me!
translations.idiomatic: Guang ran into Qiao city; Shaozong said, "Now how is it, that you blame me!

sentences.zh: 」光，金之子也。

translations.literal: " Guang was Jin's son.
translations.idiomatic: " Guang was the son of Hulu Jin.

sentences.zh: 開府儀同三司段韶夾渦而軍，潛於上風縱火，景帥騎入水，出而卻走，草濕，火不復然。

translations.literal: Opening the Mansion Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes Duan Shao encamped on both sides of the Wo; secretly he set fire upwind; Jing led cavalry into the water, came out and retreated—the grass was wet and the fire would not catch again.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Shao, Opening the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes, encamped on both sides of the Wo; secretly he set fire upwind; Hou Jing led cavalry into the water, came out and retreated—the grass was wet and the fire would not catch.

sentences.zh: 魏岐州久經喪亂，刺史鄭穆初到，有戶三千，穆撫循安集，數年之間，至四萬餘戶，考績為諸州之最；

translations.literal: Wei's Qi province had long suffered disorder; when inspector Zheng Mu first arrived there were three thousand households; Mu comforted and settled them, and within several years there were more than forty thousand households; his assessment ranked first among the provinces;
translations.idiomatic: Qi province of Western Wei had long suffered disorder; when inspector Zheng Mu first arrived there were three thousand households; Mu comforted and settled them, and within several years there were more than forty thousand; his assessment ranked first among the provinces;

sentences.zh: 丞相泰擢穆為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Chancellor Tai promoted Mu to Governor of the Capital District.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai promoted Mu to Governor of the Capital District.

sentences.zh: 侯景與東魏慕容紹宗相持數月，景食盡，司馬世雲降於紹宗。

translations.literal: Hou Jing and Eastern Wei's Murong Shaozong faced each other for months; Jing's food was exhausted, and Sima Shiyun surrendered to Shaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing and Murong Shaozong of Eastern Wei faced each other for months; Hou Jing's food was exhausted, and Sima Shiyun surrendered to Shaozong.
